spec.claim_summary: Long BTC on 4H when Supertrend flips from downtrend to uptrend, with an ATR-based stop and exit on the opposite Supertrend flip, including a partial 0.75R take-profit.
assumptions: Supertrend settings not stated, used default ATR length 10 and multiplier 3.
Entry 'Supertrend changes from downtrend to uptrend' compiled as close crosses_above supertrend on bar close.
Exit 'Supertrend changes from uptrend to downtrend' compiled as close crosses_below supertrend on bar close.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit closing half position at 0.75R and holding remainder to Supertrend flip; spec uses take_profit_r 0.75 for the full position as closest testable core plus Supertrend-flip exit.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving stop loss to breakeven after first 0.75R profit; schema has no breakeven-move, original ATR stop is retained.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: 'atr stop loss' gives no multiplier or length; used stop_atr_mult 2.0 with stop_atr_period 14 as concrete placeholder.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss
The first profit will be of 0.75 risk/reward ratio where half position will be closed.

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim closes only half position at 0.75R and holds remainder to Supertrend flip; spec encodes take_profit_r 0.75 as exit for full position, changing exposure and returns.
trailing_stop_pct: Claim moves stop loss to breakeven after 0.75R partial profit; spec retains original ATR stop with no breakeven move, changing downside on remainder.
